answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable work bond before answering, recorded on a public ledger like a ridge line that every observer can trace. Honest, jury-approved work returns the bond gradually, while a caught copy forfeits it. A single real agent pays once and earns it back, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity — as solid and costly as carving each fake from a fresh block of marble rather than stamping copies. Even a polished, jade-looking fake still costs a full bond, so flooding the network costs more than the rewards it could ever collect.
